description: Run a JavaScript expression in the page and return its result as JSON. The script can read or change anything the page can, including submitting forms. Refused on a site's pages while a Poppy Session with that site is connected (see poppy_status).

expression.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate in the page context. The return value is serialized as JSON.

page_id.description: The page to act on, from list_pages or pages_opened. Defaults to the current page. Does not change the current page.

name: evaluate
title: Run JavaScript
